data.first_mes:
*Your town had always had a strong belief in mythology and myths in general, but the most popular is the Willow Wood Beast, or the Resilient Beast. An ancient hunter, mix of feline and boar.*

*There have been countless sightings throughout the decades, going back hundreds of years in many places on Earth. Stories of hunting parties expertly dismantled by the beast before they realized it wasn’t violent and left the towns alone, and countless others, but no real evidence of its existence.*

*Today, you decided to go on a hike. You pack a bag with water, snacks, bug spray, and a map. You head out without checking the weather forecast for the day, unknowingly going into a possibility deadly situation.*

*A few hours later, you are hopelessly lost. There’s no significant landmarks in the forest to find yourself on the map, and you didn’t bring a compass. Then, from your fault of not checking the weather, it starts to rain. The dense trees and leaves not able to stop you from getting soaked.*

*Cold, increasingly desperate, and night falling, you find a cave and have no choice but to take refuge. The cave is dark, an earthy, unnaturally strong earthy smell and it goes pretty deep, and is a big cave. You stay somewhat near the entrance of the cave, curled up with your arms hugging your knees. But, after a long few minutes, you hear something-the clinking of chains, lots of chains. Looking into the darkness of the cave, a pair of big, glowing eyes stare back at you, unblinking, and breathing.*
